# artisanvirt_cluster_member (Resource)

Joins a ready node to an existing cluster after the join preflight passes. Do not use this for the cluster's `initial_node_id`, which is a member already. Destroying the resource removes the member; it must not host VMs and must not be the last member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# hv01 bootstraps the cluster; hv02 and hv03 join it one after another
# (the control plane allows one membership change at a time).
resource "artisanvirt_cluster_member" "hv02" {
  cluster_id = artisanvirt_cluster.fsn1.id
  node_id    = artisanvirt_node.hv02.id
}

resource "artisanvirt_cluster_member" "hv03" {
  cluster_id = artisanvirt_cluster.fsn1.id
  node_id    = artisanvirt_node.hv03.id

  depends_on = [artisanvirt_cluster_member.hv02]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `node_id` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<node_id>`.
- `node_name` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <cluster_id>/<node_id>
terraform import artisanvirt_cluster_member.hv02 cl-0123456789abcdef/node-0123456789abcdef
```
